content:
Maya L: posted a near-final draft in the drive: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/optimize-v2 — focus is launch blog + webinar CTA. need quick eyes on headline variants and form routing.
Carlos V: read 1st pass. suggestion: run 2 headline variants in the article hero A/B test: 'Ship LLM features faster' vs 'Reduce inference cost by Xx'. which do we want lead with for webinar registrants?
Tess H: for webinar we should lead with speed (ship faster) — better for product engineers. but for benchmark readers, cost headline might win. propose hero headline = speed, subhead includes cost stat.
Maya L: agree. hero = speed, subhead: "Up to 3x lower token cost in production workloads" (we'll sanity-check metric).
Priya S: routing: if hero CTA = "Register for live demo", we need two form variants on the landing page (webinar vs on-demand). mapping below: 
webinar_form -> list: Launch_Webinar_2026 -> workflow: webinar_attend_flow
demo_on_demand_form -> list: Launch_OnDemand_2026 -> workflow: nurture_trial_flow
Also adding hidden field: use_case_tag (values: embeddings, generation, rerank). SDRs asked for this.
Sam R: small ops note: ensure double opt-in enabled for webinar list and that HubSpot UTM -> source mapping includes campaign=optimize_launch2026.
ContentOps Bot: checklist update: draft linked, hero image placeholder present, headline variants noted, webinar form created (draft), hidden fields: pending, legal quote: pending.
Carlos V: legal: we can't use the exact "3x" claim without internal perf sign-off. can we change to 'up to 3x' and add a footnote to appendix with test context?
Tess H: i'll move the deep benchmarking tables into a collapsible appendix and add test notes (models, token lengths, batch sizes).
Maya L: can someone pull the benchmark screenshots for the appendix? prefer cropped graphs (png) rather than raw csv.
Sam R: tagging @Infra to export perf graphs. note: need axis labels and test config included.
Priya S: CRO ask: add a 2nd CTA for 'Get the benchmark report' to capture folks who don't want to attend a webinar. map that form to a gated asset list: Bench_Report_2026 -> workflow: bench_download_flow.
Carlos V: good call. adds lead tiering: webinar leads -> SDR immediate follow-up; bench report -> nurture for 2 weeks.
Maya L: creative: hero mock incoming from Ben in 30m. if legal ok by EOD, we can schedule publish + social for 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Tess H: quick copy nit: change 'developer-first' to 'developer-first inference' in the first paragraph.
Maya L: done. updated doc.
ContentOps Bot: preflight test list created: 1) HubSpot forms wired, 2) hidden fields validated, 3) UTM mapping, 4) double opt-in for webinar list, 5) social cards uploaded, 6) legal quote approval. Reminder set for 1775560200 (10m before release checklist).
Priya S: i'm running the hidden field test now — will post results in thread.
Sam R: if all tests green, i'll lock the publish window and ping comms for cross-post.
Maya L: thanks everyone. action items: Priya finalizes routing/tests, Carlos chases legal quote sign-off, Ben uploads hero, Tess finalizes appendix. Target: publish tomorrow 09:00 PT. :sparkles:
